removed.text: It takes the shape of a crow and perches on the last standing sheaf to watch the reapers.
removed.reason: machal1918:p.269 (and p.268) say nothing about a crow or about the polevik perching on the last sheaf; a find for 'crow' in machal1918 and for 'last sheaf' across the corpus turned up no page that does.

grade_rationale.text: Machal records the polevik for the Russians.
Afanasyev records poleviki, as tall as the growing grain and shrinking to stubble after harvest, in the Kiev and Chernigov Governments, which the people table maps to Ukrainians.
Machal's polevik passage cites no source on the page, so Machal and Afanasyev are counted as two independent authors; Afanasyev's two volumes count as one source.
